runtime/crypto#

The native layer under http/cache_admission, http/digest: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under http/cache_admission, http/digest: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native digest#

native digest(algorithm is string, origin is @byte) is @byte

Existing core.crypto ABI; no provider or interpreter changes.

native secure_equal#

native secure_equal(left is @byte, right is @byte) is bool

Whether left and right are equal, in time that depends only on their lengths.
